Tooltip_DansClimate_InstallFacing: The controls face the side you're standing on. Install it from inside the room you want to cool.
Tooltip_DansClimate_NotAWindow: This isn't a window that can hold an air conditioner.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HasUnit: There's already an air conditioner in this window.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ACOff: Switched off. Its dial is at %1, its fan on %2.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ACCooling: Running: cooling the room to %1, fan on %2.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ACIdle: Switched on, fan on %2. The room is already down to %1, so it's only ticking over.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HeaterOff: Switched off. Its dial is at %1, on %2.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HeaterHeating: Running on %2: heating the room to %1.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HeaterIdle: Switched on, on %2. The room is already up to %1, so its elements are off for now.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HvacNoPower: The power is out, and the building's heating and cooling went with it. A generator won't bring them back. <LINE> Keep the room warm with a fire or a space heater, and cool with a window air conditioner.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Thermostat_OFF: The building's heating and cooling are switched off.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Thermostat_HEAT: Heats the building to %1. No cooling.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Thermostat_COOL: Cools the building to %2. No heating.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Thermostat_AUTO: Heats the building to %1 and cools it to %2.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HVACFurnaceItem: A heavy electric furnace. Installed in a building, it heats every room that has a vent. Installing it takes know-how: a manual, and skill in Welding, Maintenance and Electrical.
Tooltip_DansClimate_HVACCondenserItem: The outdoor unit of a central air conditioner, and heavy. Installed against a building's wall, it cools every room that has a vent. Installing it takes know-how: a manual, and skill in Welding, Maintenance and Electrical.
Tooltip_craft_DansClimateFurnaceDesc: An electric furnace. Build it inside a room of a building: it heats every room of that building that has a vent, to the thermostat's setting. It runs on a generator and burns a lot of fuel while it works.
Tooltip_craft_DansClimateCentralACDesc: A central air conditioner's outdoor unit. Build it outdoors, right against a wall of a building: it cools every room of that building that has a vent, to the thermostat's setting. It runs on a generator, and zombies hear it working.
Tooltip_craft_DansClimateVentDesc: A floor vent. A furnace and a central air conditioner only reach the rooms that have one. Their output is shared: the more floor you vent, the slower each room warms or cools.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_NoBuilding: It heats nothing here. A furnace has to stand inside a room of a building.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_NoPower: No power. It needs a generator that reaches it.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_NoVents: No room in this building has a vent yet. Build a vent in each room it should heat.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_Idle: Standing by: the thermostat isn't asking for heat.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_Running: Working: heating the rooms that have a vent, to the thermostat's setting.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Furnace_Thin: Working, but spread thin: the rooms with a vent are %1 times the floor one furnace heats at full strength, so each warms that much slower. Fewer vents or a second furnace would fix it.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_NoBuilding: It cools nothing here. A central air conditioner has to stand outdoors, right against a wall of the building it cools.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_NoPower: No power. It needs a generator that reaches it.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_NoVents: No room in this building has a vent yet. Build a vent in each room it should cool.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_Idle: Standing by: the thermostat isn't asking for cooling.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_Running: Working: cooling the rooms that have a vent, to the thermostat's setting.
Tooltip_DansClimate_CentralAC_Thin: Working, but spread thin: the rooms with a vent are %1 times the floor one unit cools at full strength, so each cools that much slower. Fewer vents or a second unit would fix it.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Vent_NoRoom: A vent only works inside a room of a building.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Vent_None: Connected to nothing yet: this building has no furnace and no central air conditioner.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Vent_Heat: This room is heated by the building's furnace.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Vent_Cool: This room is cooled by the building's central air conditioner.
Tooltip_DansClimate_Vent_Both: This room is heated by the building's furnace and cooled by its central air conditioner.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ThermostatCentral_He: The power is out: it runs your furnace, in the rooms with a vent. Nothing cools the building.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ThermostatCentral_Co: The power is out: it runs your central air conditioner, in the rooms with a vent. Nothing heats the building.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ThermostatCentral_Bo: The power is out: it runs your furnace and your central air conditioner, in the rooms with a vent.
Tooltip_DansClimate_ComfortBand: Dressed as you are, you're comfortable from %1 to %2.
